sentences.text: Due to the impact of the said accident, the claimant fell down and sustained grievous injuries.

It is the case of the insurance NC:
2023:KHC:33397 company that in the Medico Legal Register the person who had admitted the claimant had given two car numbers i.e., one number is the car insured by the insurance company and another car.
In the discharge summary i.e., Exhibit-R6 Discharge Summary, it is mentioned that the claimant was hit by a tempo trolley.
The insurance company had denied the involvement of the vehicle insured and according to them the said vehicle is implicated for the purpose of claiming compensation.

It is also their case that the Investigator had written a letter to the hospital authorities wherein they have mentioned about the involvement of the other vehicle which is mentioned in the MLC Register i.e., KA-03/MD-3497 and not the insured vehicle.

3. The court below considered the evidence led-in by both the parties i.e., evidence of PW-1 to PW-3,
Exhibits-P1 to P16, evidence of RW-1 and RW-2 and Exhibits-R1 to R6.
The car numbers are mentioned by the person who had admitted the claimant in the hospital.
The NC: 2023:KHC:33397 claimant was unconscious at that point of time and immediately after regaining conscious he had given the statement to the Police.
Basing on the same, a crime was registered.

In the said complaint he has given the correct number of the car involved in the accident and hence the entry of two car numbers in MLC register cannot be a ground for the Court for disbelieving the involvement of the vehicle.
The court below also observed that a charge- sheet was filed against the respondent insured vehicle.
Basing on that the court below had come to the conclusion that the accident had taken place because of the rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle.

4. When it comes to the injuries sustained by the claimant in the accident, it is seen that the claimant had sustained (i) pain and deformity of left thigh, (ii) left earning lobe lacerated, (iii) left forearm laceration left meaense, (iv) head injury-bleeding from nose.
As per the opinion of the Doctor injuries (i) and (iii) are grievous in nature and as per the X-ray reports the petitioner had NC: 2023:KHC:33397 sustained fracture of shaft of femur.

Considering this, the court below under the head of pain and suffering had granted an amount of Rs.40,000/-, towards medical bills an amount of Rs.30,000/-, towards conveyance food, nourishment and attendant an amount of Rs.15,000/-.

When it comes to loss of earning during treatment period, it is the case of the claimant that he was working as a coolie and he was earning an amount of Rs.10,000/- p.m., and as there was no evidence the court below had taken the income of the claimant as Rs.3,500/- per month and granted an amount of Rs.17,500/-.

When it comes to loss of future earning, it is the evidence of the doctor that the claimant had suffered disability to the left knee at 2% and thigh at 4% and 2% to the left elbow and 18% is the instability.

The court below, as per the evidence of the doctor considering the disability to the left knee and thigh had taken 6% as the disability and income at Rs.3,500/-
p.m., and on applying the relevant multiplier 17 had granted an amount of Rs.42,480/- (3,500 x 12 x 17 x 6%).
